label: churn100-s4-c2
resisted: Nothing structural: no hidden node needed splitting (5 input splits, 1 consolidation of the customer-service-calls copies). 6089 (state:18 / 21+ voicemail messages) has logit weight 0.005 (at most +0.05): negligible. The state:39 pair (1295 -> 7872) is a constant -2.33 logit switched off for state:39, almost cancelling state:39's direct -2.61 (net -0.25 vs empirical -0.93). The service-call threshold is placed right (3 -> 4 calls) but the model under-predicts at 4 calls (0.33 vs 0.44) and is over-confident from 5 calls (0.75-0.99 vs 0.55-0.68; 119 customers). state:18 gets +0.41 logit against an empirical -0.48 (65 rows). closed_form_max_abs_err 0.020 (vmail_state18_unit) is 3-significant-figure rounding; numeric error 1.8e-15.
tool_bugs: None new. Hidden-node splits were not needed; input splits were done before the one consolidation. Display name of the consolidated copy -71_acd is None (cosmetic). Tool calls driven from scratch Python scripts that run experiments/species_leads/xn.py per call (all logged), because the Bash sandbox refuses shell variables/loops around uv.
summary: logit P(churn) = -1.30 + a sparse linear backbone over 29 inputs (voicemail plan -1.12 per SD, international plan +0.83, voicemail messages +0.62, evening charge +0.35, international minutes +0.34, state offsets) + a customer-service-calls threshold (two hinges: nothing for 0-2 calls, then about +2.4 logit per call from 4) + two day-usage hinges (nothing below about 210 day minutes, then steeply up, +4.3 logit above 280 minutes; the 3118 hinge only for customers without voicemail messages, the 10131 hinge off in state:47) + a small evening-minutes hinge and exact state:39/state:15 offsets, all additive in the logit. Day minutes and service calls have no linear term. Train AUC 0.891, accuracy 0.888. Compared with the run's cluster-1 lead (churn100-s4, key 24573), the same two thresholds (service calls, high day usage) carry the nonlinearity, but here day usage is gated by voicemail messages and state:47 rather than combined with evening minutes.

analysis.method: local numpy forward passes on in-memory copies of the original phenotype; mean ablation = unit exits set to their train mean; linear replacement = each exit replaced by its least-squares fit on the unit's raw inputs

performance_sources.conclusion: Of +0.058 above all-linear (0.8333 -> 0.8908), the day-usage hinges alone recover +0.037 (0.8707) and the service-call threshold alone +0.033 (0.8659); together they recover all of it (0.8907), so they are complementary. Evening, state and voicemail units contribute nothing to ranking (state units exactly linear). The all-linearised network (0.833) is below a refitted L2 logistic regression (0.843).

rare_category_switches.logit_effect: mean +0.90 (range -1.52..+1.23): +1.23 direct, but switches off 10131 in day_usage_hinges
